params.name: aTable
params.description: Table to display and modify, or the default table if omitted.

params.name: * (first)
params.description: Use the output form for a one-record selection and hide scroll bars in the input form.

params.name: * (second)
params.description: Show scroll bars in the input form, overriding the scroll-bar-hiding effect of the first '*'.

overloads.semanticRole: Displays the current selection of aTable (or the default table) in list mode or, on double-click, in an input form where the record can be edited in Read-Write mode (unlike DISPLAY SELECTION, which is read-only).

interactionNotes.note: The second '*' can only be passed if the first '*' is also passed (in the doc syntax it appears as a mandatory placeholder once the second '*' is used). The second '*' overrides only the scroll-bar-hiding part of the first '*''s effect, re-enabling scroll bars in the input form; the one-record-selection output-form behavior of the first '*' still applies.

constraints: Places all records of the selection in Read-Write mode (locked for writing in other processes) while displayed; records are freed when the command finishes.
